description: Touches of the MongoDB connector for the native smoke (report 15 §6): the validator without I/O, the driver with its error mapping, and mongodb+srv:// through the gateway's own DNS client (the image has no JNDI DNS provider). The first two need no server; the third needs a mongod with access control and TLS only (fixture mongod-srv: the 8.0.23 binary of flapdoodle or GW_MONGOD_BIN, a CA of its own, the users of report 05 §8) and a DNS server on UDP answering SRV _mongodb._tcp.<srvHost> → 127.0.0.1:<port> and TXT authSource=admin, passed to the core as -Dgateway.test.dns-server=<host:port> (ignored by a release). The app's MongoCoreProcessIT runs the same touch with -Dgateway.core.binary.
